description: Insert a rows×columns table, optionally populated from a 2D array of cell text — cell text may use inline markdown (**bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](url)). Per-column alignment via align. Position via at (top/end/or a unique text anchor, default end). A direct edit, not a tracked suggestion.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

align.description: per-column text alignment, e.g. ["left","right"]; null or "left" leaves a column at the default

at.description: "top", "end", or a unique text snippet to insert after (default end)

columnWidths.description: fixed width per column, in points

createSegment.description: when segment is header/footer and the doc has none, create it first. Only the default header/footer can be created via the API.

headerShade.description: hex background color for the first row, e.g. #f1f3f4

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

tab.description: Target a specific tab by tabId or title (from list_tabs). Defaults to the first tab.

name: insert_table
title: Insert a table
